chunks: Hammad narrated from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said: Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:

The time of Maghrib is when the disk disappears. If you see it after that, and you have already prayed, you must repeat the salat (prayer), while your sawm (fast) remains valid, and you must refrain from food if you had consumed any of it.

key_terms.غَابَ الْقُرْصُ: the disappearance of the sun's disk

ai.seo_question: What should a fasting person do if the sun appears again after breaking the fast or praying Maghrib?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the beginning of Maghrib and the consequences of mistakenly acting before sunset is fully established. It states that if the sun's disk reappears after one has prayed or eaten, the Maghrib salat (prayer) must be repeated, while the sawm (fast) remains valid, though one must immediately stop eating.
